grader.scenario: Refund for cancelled order delayed by 4 weeks; agent tells customer to 'get lost' [AUTO-FAIL]
grader.notes: Immediate AUTO-FAIL call where the agent failed branding, verbally abused customer telling her to 'get lost', and left delayed refund unresolved, resulting in an automatic final score of 0.0.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('S-Net cancellations audit...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Penelope throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed intense rage and distress at turn 21; agent offered zero empathy, leaving the outburst unhandled.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the refund delay issue in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for cancellation reference at turn 42 despite customer stating CN-882190 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent refused to expedite refund and told customer to wait 28 days for a cheque.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent told customer to 'get lost' at turn 17 ('Listen lady, if you don't like our refund timelines, you can get lost...').

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked for cancellation date and payment details.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Refund was not processed, customer threatened regulatory action and bank chargeback.
